cohort: Pregnant women at risk of perinatal stress and depression were randomized to either a Mindfulness-Based Childbirth and Parenting Program or a Lamaze program, and their infants were followed.
finding: Infants in the Mindfulness-Based Childbirth and Parenting Program (MBCP) group showed better social-emotional development compared to infants in the Lamaze group, and MBCP was associated with lower rates of maternal postpartum depression.
